cohort.window: October 1 through earliest maximum positive observed SWE date inclusive
cohort.aggregation: sum per tuple to hour to water-year, then Python statistics.median across water years; never add separately reduced medians

forcing_custody.provider_statement: fixture documentation labels daily precipitation/temperature DAYMET, daily wind GRIDMET, sub-daily storm patterns CLIGEN, and spatial revision PRISM
forcing_custody.consumed_surface: the daily CLI w-vl value is repeated into each Stage 3 hourly/substep tuple
forcing_custody.exposure_status_before_audit: UNKNOWN; no retained metadata establishes open-site, above-canopy, within-canopy, or sub-canopy exposure
forcing_custody.virtual_geometry: z_T=z_q=z_u=5 m above the instantaneous modeled snow surface and z_0,aero=0.005 m are model metadata, not a physical instrument claim

operators.S: immutable whole-column same-state external carrier; raw vapor opportunity only
operators.F: consumer-only frozen-active external carrier; raw vapor opportunity only
operators.Q: within-day sequential resolved-state carrier; physical mass transfer is bounded deposition/sublimation and endpoint change
operators.common_support: three-way prefix minimum per joined hour, retaining all-evaluated results separately
operators.evolution_attribution: Q-F per-water-year totals for shortwave, longwave, sensible, latent, advected, raw vapor; Q-only bounded deposition/sublimation, endpoint mass, temperature, cold content, active volume, humidity gradient, stability class, exchange velocity, and support summaries

mass_semantics.raw_vapor: signed exchange opportunity; positive deposition, negative sublimation
mass_semantics.sequential_actual_transfer: non-negative bounded sublimation/deposition plus total-ice endpoints
mass_semantics.independent_bounded_vapor_transfer: from independently reconstructed raw vapor and pre-transfer active ice: deposition=max(raw_vapor,0); sublimation=min(max(-raw_vapor,0),active_ice_mass_before); this consumes no producer deposition, sublimation, melt, or mass endpoint
mass_semantics.producer_transfer_comparison: for each Q tuple independently_reconstructed_deposition must equal producer deposition and independently_reconstructed_sublimation must equal producer sublimation under max(1e-12 kg m^-2,1e-12*sum_abs_operands), before any aggregation; same-sign wrong magnitude is invalid evidence
mass_semantics.independent_melt: for each Q tuple reconstruct in operator order without post-transfer endpoints: C0=active_cold_before; G=internal_active_lower_conduction; C1=C0-G; E=independently reconstructed external_flux*duration; surface_change=(E>=0 ? min(E,C1) : E); active_cold_change=G+surface_change; lower_cold_change=-G (G is zero for one-volume); q_complete=E+G; excess=max(q_complete-active_cold_change,0); ice_available=max(active_ice_before-independent_sublimation,0); melt=min(excess/333600 J kg^-1,ice_available); unallocated=max(excess-333600*melt,0). Compare derived active/lower cold changes, melt, unallocated/closure consequence to producer fields and only then use independently derived melt/transfer in post-repartition endpoint closure under scale-aware tolerances
mass_semantics.endpoint_cross_check: total_after = total_before - independently reconstructed melt - independently reconstructed sublimation + independently reconstructed deposition
mass_semantics.mutual_exclusion: independent deposition and sublimation cannot both be nonzero; producer deposition and sublimation cannot both be nonzero
forbidden_aliases: separately reduced medians as a ledger

surface_temperature_domain.predicate: finite, greater than -273.15 degC, and no resolved snow surface above 0 degC

turbulent_termination.predicate: only contract-enumerated statuses; finite reconstructed primitives; no nonconvergence laundering

net_external_energy_magnitude.reason: no admitted site/season/forest-comparable numeric envelope was located before result execution

sensible_latent_magnitude.reason: no admitted site/season/forest-comparable numeric envelope was located before result execution

bounded_sublimation_deposition_magnitude.reason: no admitted site/season/forest-comparable numeric envelope was located before result execution

raw_vapor_opportunity_magnitude.reason: no admitted site/season/forest-comparable numeric envelope was located before result execution

stability_exchange_behavior_magnitude.reason: termination/domain/finite reconstruction is evaluable, but no admitted site/season/forest-comparable class-frequency or exchange-velocity envelope was located

stability_geometry_equation.reason: libsnobal/openWEPP parity on z/L is provenance, not independent science authority selecting z/L versus (z-d)/L

physical_predicates.persistence_rule: any NOT_EVALUABLE physical magnitude gate blocks EVOLVING_CARRIER_PLAUSIBILITY_PASS and persistence

counterfactual_budget.canopy_aerodynamic: PROHIBITED_AUTHORITY_MISSING unless a complete equation, applicability domain, and every input are admitted before results
counterfactual_budget.stability_geometry: PROHIBITED as a corrected arm unless canonical/reference authority selects a different equation; current libsnobal reference uses z/L

decision_precedence: invalid execution or reconstruction, including any producer-versus-independent deposition/sublimation/melt disagreement, endpoint disagreement, or S/F numeric transfer in place of required N/A -> package HOLD; these are not scientific mechanism classes
the per-site exposure field is unknown at freeze -> WIND_FORCING_EXPOSURE_UNRESOLVED

CANOPY_AERODYNAMIC_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED may be emitted only if wind exposure and applicability evidence first establish that a distinct canopy aerodynamic operator is required; absent equation authority alone records AUTHORITY_MISSING and prohibits the counterfactual but does not prove the class

after all evidence-validity checks pass, any Q tuple with negative raw opportunity whose magnitude exceeds active_ice_mass_before under max(1e-12 kg m^-2,1e-12*sum_abs_operands), so valid independently bounded sublimation is smaller than raw opportunity, -> VAPOR_OPPORTUNITY_TRANSFER_MISMATCH; report capacity-truncated tuple count and mass before WY/site aggregation so errors cannot cancel

TURBULENT_STABILITY_GEOMETRY_DEFECT may be emitted only if canonical equation authority selects z/L or (z-d)/L and current execution differs; current libsnobal/openWEPP z/L parity alone is not science authority, so geometry remains NOT_EVALUABLE and no defect class is emitted

any resolved tuple has nonfinite or out-of-domain state, surface temperature <= -273.15 degC or > 0 degC, negative mass/depth/density/cold content, or fails endpoint continuity -> ACTIVE_STATE_EVOLUTION_PLAUSIBILITY_FAIL
COMPENSATING_TERM_ERROR is NOT_EVALUABLE and cannot be emitted because no admitted magnitude threshold exists
MULTIFACTOR_OR_INCONCLUSIVE is emitted whenever more than one unresolved/nonexclusive mechanism class remains or the unique F-to-Q crossing attribution is not identified
classification_reduction: evaluate predicates per eligible water year; report counts and site medians, but any qualifying canonical-site WY is retained and cannot be erased by a median. Canonical sites determine persistence. Snowbird is reported but non-decisive. Classes are nonexclusive except EVOLVING_CARRIER_PLAUSIBILITY_PASS, which requires every physical gate PASS and no other class.
required_adversarial_tests: negative/nonfinite melt, deposition, sublimation, state, and endpoint
same-sign wrong producer deposition or sublimation magnitude
raw-positive with sublimation and raw-negative with deposition
same-sign wrong melt magnitude with compensating vapor transfer
active endpoint substituted for total endpoint
numeric-zero Q transfer copied into S/F instead of N/A
duplicate, reordered, or gapped tuple support
termination status, iterations, L, and psi mismatch
F first-Q state versus S whole-column fingerprint alias
no_tuning: No cohort, role, support, estimator, threshold, counterfactual, equation, or decision predicate may change after new attribution output is inspected.
